traceability.notes:
This IS a valid specification story. Most of the story’s requirements have been implemented and are well-covered by unit and (conditionally) by integration tests: - Dual-position detection for else-if (before-else and between condition/body) is implemented via gatherElseIfCommentText and its helpers and validated by tests. - Fallback logic and position priority are implemented and tested. - Prettier-compatible auto-fix placement for else-if branches with BlockStatement consequents is implemented and tested. - The require-branch-annotation rule is wired to use the new helpers for IfStatement/else-if branches, and all existing branch-related tests pass.
However, the acceptance criterion **“Single-Line Support: Annotations on single-line else-if statements without braces are properly detected and validated”** and corresponding requirement **REQ-SINGLE-LINE-ELSE-IF-SUPPORT** are not explicitly implemented or tested: - The story itself leaves this acceptance criterion unchecked, signaling it as outstanding. - The else-if-specific scanning and Prettier-compatible behavior are conditioned on the consequent being a BlockStatement; there is no dedicated behavior or test coverage for single-line else-if statements without braces beyond the generic ‘before-else’ comment handling. - No test cases reference REQ-SINGLE-LINE-ELSE-IF-SUPPORT or exercise the concrete real-world single-line pattern described in the story.
Because at least one explicit acceptance criterion and requirement remain unmet (and are acknowledged as such in the story), this story cannot be considered fully implemented. Status: FAILED.
